style.styleTitle: Scottish Everlastings Ltd Classic Christmas Garland
style.toneOfVoice: Bring timeless festive charm into your home with this beautifully crafted 180cm classic red & green Christmas garland. Designed to capture the essence of traditional Christmas décor, this lush garland blends rich green foliage with vibrant red accents to create a warm and inviting seasonal display. Full and realistic in appearance, the garland features a mix of lifelike evergreen branches, carefully arranged to reflect the natural texture and depth of fresh pine. Pops of classic red detailing provide a cheerful contrast, making it a perfect statement piece for mantelpieces, staircases, doorways, or dining tables. Measuring a generous 180cm in length, it offers versatile styling options—drape it along a banister, weave it through a festive tablescape, or frame your fireplace to create an instantly cosy atmosphere. This artificial garland delivers all the beauty of fresh greenery without the upkeep. Create a warm, traditional Christmas setting with this elegant garland, perfect for making your home feel truly festive. Bring indoors during adverse weather conditions. Garland Length: 180cm.
